source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED), series DHHNGSP: Henry Hub Natural Gas Spot Price, daily, dollars per million BTU, not seasonally adjusted. Underlying source: U.S. Energy Information Administration via Refinitiv.
series_description: Henry Hub natural gas daily spot price (USD/MMBtu), trimmed to observations on or after 2021-07-01 (~5 years). Empty and '.' values (market holidays) dropped.
